Name: CP x CC - Molamole's Countertops And Cabinets
Author: MolaMole
Description:
Here few -many...too many- Countertops & Cabinets ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27617]Mole's Kitchen[/url]﻿ and future mods!
due Its size they are in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35213]Molamole's Furniture Catalogue[/url] mod, with tiled countertops options selected with the [b]paint bucket[/b] tool -[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]-, so be sure to have it with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]!
